fields.name: customUpdateProxyUrl
fields.notes: host projects the persisted nullable value as the empty string

fields.name: theme
fields.notes: null means not configured and is distinct from an explicit system choice; the key itself is required

updatePatch.notes: present null is always rejected; duplicate payload keys must be rejected before JsonElement information loss; adoptLegacyTheme is a one-time compare-unset adoption and cannot be mixed with any other field

fields.name: preference
fields.notes: the key is required; null means not configured

fields.name: code
fields.notes: the host serializes unset as null (no WhenWritingNull); absent, null and string are all legal; unknown string codes are preserved as a safe diagnosable failure; number/object/array are malformed

fields.name: operationId
fields.notes: serialized as null when unset; tolerated here and not projected beyond the current bridge consumption semantics

operationFailed.notes: Settings-family operation.failed payload contract for the shared envelope. A malformed failure (missing/null message, wrong-typed metadata) is a protocol error with an unknown outcome — never success and never a claim that a sent update was not committed.

errorCodes.when: get payload is not an empty object or update payload violates updatePatch
persisting an accepted update fails; the write outcome is not inferable as not-committed because appearance/native effects may already have run
